## Executive Summary

This week is mixed and a bit messy on the data side.

- **Blue Canvas:** ranking visibility was improving in the last clean GSC pull, but **measurement is still broken/inconsistent**. GA4 web UI now shows **“No data received from your website yet”** for the currently selected property, while last week’s export showed 107 sessions and a sharp organic drop. That means **analytics cannot be trusted until tracking/property setup is cleaned up**.
- **UK Trade Jobs:** last clean GSC snapshot still showed strong early momentum — clicks up 10x WoW and impressions up 118% — but I could not pull a fresh live GSC/GA4 weekly export in this run.
- **Google Ads:** traffic volume and CTR remain strong, but **£185.57 spend this week produced 0 tracked conversions**. That is the biggest commercial issue.

I’ve used the latest verified Ahrefs baseline from 6 Mar for competitor/gap context below.

### Important live check
In GA4 web UI today, the selected property shows:
- **“No data received from your website yet”**
